name: Saskatchewan

standard.note: Saskatchewan's everyday plate carries the slogan "Land of Living Skies" in green on white.

plates.title: Saskatchewan Roughrider plates (Rider Pride)
plates.fact: With every plate ordered, $27 goes to the Rider organization.

plates.title: Vintage Rider plate
plates.fact: A retro take on the Riders plate for fans who like to keep it old school.

plates.title: Saskatchewan Rush plates
plates.fact: Every order sends $27 to the Saskatchewan Rush, the province's pro lacrosse team.

plates.title: SPCA plates
plates.fact: Every order contributes $27 to the Saskatchewan SPCA's work for animals.

plates.title: Support our Troops plates
plates.supports: Canadian Forces Morale and Welfare Services (CFMWS), Saskatchewan operations
plates.fact: CFMWS receives $30 from each plate ordered.

plates.title: Veteran plates
plates.fact: The plate is free for approved applicants, and RCMP veterans became eligible in 2022.

plates.title: Memorial Cross plates
plates.fact: It honours Memorial (Silver) Cross recipients, the loved ones of Canadian Armed Forces members who died because of their service.

notes: All images are SGI's own artwork, 1000x502 PNGs, load with no cookies (fetched with credentials omitted: 200 image/png); the URLs have no file extension at the end (Liferay /documents/ path) but serve image/png. Standard image is SGI's personalized sample (MYPL8) on the Land of Living Skies base. sgi.sk.ca/specialty-plates redirects to the home page; the real list is the 'Specialty and personalized plates' page (accordion sections). Excluded: Collector plates and Year of Manufacture plates (antique/collector), personalized and HAM call-sign options. Vintage Rider year 2014 is from the province's Dec 2014 'retro licence plates' news release; Support our Troops 2015 from the Nov 2015 backgrounder; RCMP veteran eligibility (2022) from news coverage - all from search titles, not the SGI page.
